channel.title: Kenya Broadcasting Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Kenya Broadcasting Corporation (kbc.co.ke)

item.title: Tuju plea delayed after hospitalisation at Karen Hospital
item.description: Former Cabinet Secretary Raphael Tuju’s case at Kibera Law Courts on charges of giving false information to a police officer failed to kick off after he was admitted at Karen Hospital for treatment.

item.title: Counties seek Ksh 534B in equitable share
item.description: Governors are seeking Ksh 534 billion as an equitable share for the 2026/2027 Financial Year, as Senators warned of a worrying trend of pending bills in the devolved units.

item.title: Mozambique President Daniel Chapo in Kenya for three-day working visit
item.description: President Daniel Francisco Chapo has begun a three-day working visit to Kenya aimed at strengthening bilateral relations and expanding trade and investment between the two countries.

item.title: Court issues warrant of arrest against former Java CEO
item.description: A Nairobi court has issued a warrant of arrest against former Java Chief Executive Officer Derrick Cornelius Van Houten after he failed to appear for proceedings in a Ksh7.9 million fraud case.

item.title: 32 bodies recovered from Kericho mass grave, 25 confirmed to be infants
item.description: A total of 32 bodies have been recovered from a mass grave at Makaburini Cemetery in Kericho Town, with 25 of the remains confirmed to be infants.

item.title: BingwaFest season two set to culminate in Meru this weekend
item.description: The national finals of the 2025/26 Betika BingwaFest are underway at Kinoru Stadium, bringing together Kenya’s top grassroots teams and athletes for a week-long multi-sport showdown that will culminate on Sunday, April 5, with over KES 23 million in prize money up for grabs.

item.title: Eastern Kenya Sunshine Rally champions disability inclusion, dignity
item.description: Hundreds of children with disabilities, caregivers, teachers, and local leaders gathered at Jomo Kenyatta Stadium for the Eastern Region Sunshine Rally, a flagship event aimed at celebrating children with disabilities and advocating for their full inclusion in society.

item.title: Waiguru Rolls Out Sh142M Bursaries, Issues 3,600 Free Gas Cookers
item.description: Kirinyaga Governor Anne Waiguru has commenced issuance of bursaries to needy students with the first batch in day schools Ngariama Ward receiving full funding.

item.title: Isiolo County launches GIS map to curb GBV
item.description: Isiolo County has launched a Geographic Information System (GIS) map and a contact directory to enhance the reporting and response to gender-based violence (GBV) in Ngaremara and Burat wards.

item.title: Kenya steps up livestock disease detection to protect farmers, public health
item.description: Livestock diseases continue to pose a significant threat to farmers’ livelihoods, food security and public health in Kenya.

item.title: First Lady advocates for zero emissions, sustainable energy through parterships
item.description: First Lady Rachel Ruto has called for stronger partnerships to accelerate Kenya’s transition to net-zero emissions and sustainable energy.

item.title: Platcorp Group honored at FinTech Breakthrough Awards
item.description: Impact investment management company, Platcorp Group has been recognized at this year's FinTech Breakthrough Awards for its role in advancing innovative credit solutions through technology.

item.title: Wavinya Ndeti says comedian Sammie Kioko not registered supplier | KBC Digital
item.description: Wavinya Ndeti says that while the County Government did procure uniforms from Movata Designs, Sammie Kioko is not a registered supplier.

item.title: Road Safety Association attributes Nyeri accident to negligence
item.description: The Road Safety Association of Kenya is attributing the road accident that claimed 16 lives along the Nyeri- Nyahururu road last Saturday to negligence.

item.title: Requiem service for Nyeri road crash victims to be held Tuesday next week
item.description: The requiem mass for the 16 people who perished in a road accident on the Nyeri-Nyahururu highway on Saturday will be held on April 7th.
